suffix: . Aim for approximately 1800 words. Develop concrete places, people, events, examples, and transitions rather than an outline. Use paragraphs and continue the same subject throughout. Include a few specific quantities, dates, or times where they arise naturally. Start directly with the text, without a preamble about this request.
